E_NOT_OK: the port mirroring loop-back back mode for the indexed Ethernet switch port was not activated successfully. (i.e. indexed Ethernet switch port is not available) Description Activates a given test loop-back mode of the indexed Ethernet switch port. Available via EthSwt.h
